mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix definition allows Alloy to introduce unauthorized (role, operation) pairs, which the LeastPrivilege and PermissionCompleteness assertions should catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionViolation { some r: ClinicianRole, op: OperationKind | r -> op in (Doctor -> AuditSearch) and not (r -> op in PermMatrix.Allowed) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the constraint that every access request produces exactly one audit entry allows Alloy to create access requests without corresponding audit entries, which violates the audit-completeness invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAudit { some ar: AccessRequest | no ae: AuditEntry | ae = ar.result_audit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the constraint that audit entry IDs are unique allows Alloy to create two audit entries with the same id, which violates the immutability invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAuditId { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.id = ae2.id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the care-team-membership gating constraint allows Alloy to grant permitted access to a clinician who is not on the patient's care team, violating the ownership-based access control invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthorizedAccess { some ar: AccessRequest | ar.operation = RecordsLookup and ar.result_audit.outcome = Permitted and no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.clinician = ar.requester and ctm.patient.id = ar.patient_id and ctm.status = Active }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the constraint that denied and not-found outcomes are byte-identical allows Alloy to distinguish between these outcomes, leaking information about patient existence.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InformationLeakage { some ar: AccessRequest | ar.operation = RecordsLookup and ar.result_audit.outcome = Denied and some ar2: AccessRequest | ar2.operation = RecordsLookup and ar2.result_audit.outcome = NotFoundOrDenied and ar.result_audit != ar2.result_audit }
